findings.detail: All 3734 tracked paths were inventoried; no ICS/ICAL/IFB asset exists. Empty/generated test calendars are not real holiday datasets.
Inner builder consumes QEMU_KNOWLEDGE_ICS; formal Docker launcher neither forwards it nor defines a dedicated ICS input mount. Host environment alone cannot select this data.
Current managed metadata binds absolute source path and bytes only. Publisher/document/region/year/factual conversion/rights and selected coverage need the chosen data sidecar.
No input retains an existing complete managed resource. Optional no-data/image success is not populated holiday capability; actual frozen source/image inventory must determine presence.
Official State Council CN/2026 notice provides seven intervals/33 days. Candidate contains exactly these, excludes all six makeup days, and is neither globally complete nor installed.

Current personal-calendar provider/editor supplies no authoritative regional holiday facts; Knowledge has no CalendarData import bridge. Importing user events would require a new scoped/account-isolated authorized product contract.

candidate.line_ending: LF, explicitly accepted by the bounded producer Lines function; not a claim of full RFC5545 conformance

autonomously_actionable: Review and freeze this official CN/2026 factual candidate and source/rights sidecar, without requiring a user-created ICS
Root can fix exact Docker forwarding/read-only input selection in the next collected repair batch
Bind selected data/provenance to actual source/package/archive and add explicit populated-data coverage checks
Run actual producer and new-image public-service permission/account/photo-boundary acceptance without substituting host data or root SQL
user_materials_or_choices_needed: Only if a different jurisdiction/year/holiday definition is required: specify scope and an authoritative or licensed source; there is no need to ask for already-public CN/2026 dates
For private/commercial organization calendars, supply actual permitted content and redistribution authorization rather than treating code licenses as data licenses

integration_requests.request: After current representative attempt completes, explicitly forward QEMU_KNOWLEDGE_ICS, provide a stable read-only candidate/source sidecar input mount and input hash binding. Do not mutate current frozen attempt.

Choose exact scoped dataset; preserve source/rights/coverage sidecar in release evidence. Distinguish optional empty mode from a release requiring populated scoped holidays; consider guarded explicit removal for managed stale assets.

Validate exact candidate using the real producer then newly packaged real service/public field7 with legitimate roles, actual photo dates and boundary/account/revocation evidence. No source changes are proposed in this review.
